title: Exercise: The fundamental theorem of calculus

cues.en: When you are studying calculus, you will come across something called the fundamental theorem of calculus, which has two parts.
cues.zh: 學微積分時，會遇到所謂微積分基本定理，分成兩部分。

cues.en: The first part is essentially saying that the derivative and the integral are opposite of each other, and that's usually expressed in some formula that might look something like this.
cues.zh: 第一部分基本上是說，求導和積分互為反運算，通常用像這樣的公式表達。

cues.en: So the derivative of a function and then the integral over the derivative of the function gives you back the original function itself.
cues.zh: 先求函數的導數，再對導數積分，就會回到原函數。

cues.en: You might also see it written the other way.
cues.zh: 也可能看到反過來的寫法。

cues.en: So first you integrate over a function and then you compute the derivative of that integral and you get back the function itself.
cues.zh: 先對函數積分，再對積分結果求導，就得到函數本身。

cues.en: Now, there is actually a little bit of ambiguity in here because when you compute the integral, you
cues.zh: 不過這裡有點模糊，因為積分時，

cues.en: also get a constant at the end, a constant term, but ignoring the constant term for now, basically this is saying that integration and derivation are the opposite of each other.
cues.zh: 結尾還會有常數項；暫時忽略常數項，基本上就是說積分和求導互為反運算。

cues.en: And so your goal in this exercise is to illustrate this concept using a specific function, and that is two times X cubed plus the sign of X..
cues.zh: 這個練習，要用特定函數說明概念，就是2乘x立方，加sin(x)。

cues.zh: 函數求導，接著計算函數導數的不定積分。

cues.en: And hopefully if you haven't made any coding errors, then you will get back the original function, which is of course, this thing.
cues.zh: 希望在沒有程式錯誤的情況下，會回到原函數，也就是這個。

cues.en: So in this video and in the previous video, I introduced you to the concept of an integral, which
cues.zh: 所以這段和上一段介紹積分概念，

cues.en: is all about finding the area under some curve, and it's basically implemented as adding together a lot of really, really tiny, thin slivers of bars.
cues.zh: 也就是找曲線下方面積，基本做法，是把許多非常細小的長條薄片加起來。

cues.en: You saw how to compute the definite and indefinite integral in Python.
cues.zh: 你看到如何在Python計算定積分和不定積分。

cues.en: And in this exercise, you saw that the integral is the inverse of the derivative, which is also known as the first part of the fundamental theorem of calculus.
cues.zh: 這個練習則看到，積分是求導的反運算，也稱為微積分基本定理第一部分。
